name: Robe of the Archmagi
summary: A robe that improves your AC, spell save DC, spell attacks, and resistance to spells.

attunement.requirement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

stats.effect:
This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth and adorned with runes.

You gain these benefits while wearing the robe.

***Armor.*** If you aren't wearing armor, your base {ref:glossary/armor-class} is 15 plus your Dexterity modifier.

***Magic Resistance.*** You have {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

***War Mage.*** Your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.
